items.t: Timing chain tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
items.note: If the chain has already jumped, valves or the whole engine may need replacing, which can cost $4,000 to $11,000.

items.t: Intake manifold flap failure
items.note: Owners report $500-$1,200 total; cleaning carbon from the valves at the same time adds cost.

items.t: Water pump leaks coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing

items.t: Ignition coil failure and misfires
items.job: Replace ignition coil (one) and spark plugs
items.note: Replacing all four coils costs more; a single coil is often under $100 in parts.

items.t: Carbon buildup on intake valves
High-pressure fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and cam follower

items.t: Fuel pump control module can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: PCV valve failure and oil leaks
Rear main seal oil leak
Fuel injector failure
items.job: Replace fuel injector with new seals
items.note: Replacing all four injectors costs more.

items.t: Turbo diverter valve or wastegate rattle
items.job: Replace diverter valve or install wastegate clip
items.note: If the turbo itself is worn, a rebuild or replacement can run $1,500-$4,500.

items.t: Throttle body or wiring fault causes EPC light
items.job: Replace throttle body or repair connector

items.t: Brake vacuum pump oil leak
items.job: Reseal or replace brake vacuum pump

items.t: DSG transmission shudder or erratic shifting
items.note: Clutch pack or mechatronic replacement runs $2,000-$5,000.

items.t: Takata driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture on 2015-2017 models (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Clock spring damage can disable the driver airbag (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Airbag control unit can fail (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Wrong front head restraints may be fitted (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Rear child locks can switch off (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Passenger seat belt wiring can switch off the airbag (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Port-installed wheels may lack proper tire pressure sensors (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Cupped or uneven front tire wear
items.job: Four-wheel alignment and pair of tires

items.t: Worn struts and strut mounts
Headlight and tail light bulb failures
items.note: Xenon bulbs cost much more than halogen.

items.t: Radio and navigation unit freezes or fails
items.note: Owner-reported replacement about $2,000; a software update may fix it for less.

items.t: Exterior trim and roof molding coming loose
